items.title: 分析：英国新预算案对加密货币免新税，但监管趋严
items.raw_excerpt: 英国财政大臣里夫斯在周三发布的《秋季财政声明》中，未进一步提高去年已影响加密货币投资者的资本利得税税率。双子座（Gemini）英国合规主管Azariah Nukajam对这一决定表示欢迎。“很高兴看到加密货币不会被征新税，这意味着加密货币正被视为与其他资产类别同等的存在，确保其长期成为可行的另类投资选择，”她表示。 不过，Nukajam指出，英国近期的立法和监管公告（如《成文法文件草案》中针对加密货币公司的拟议新规），再加上此次预算案声明，表明“更严格、更接近‘传统金融’模式的监管以及税务透明度要求将按计划推进”。（新浪财经）

title_i18n.zh: 分析：英国新预算案对加密货币免新税，但监管趋严
title_i18n.en: Analysis: UK's new budget exempts cryptocurrencies from new taxes but tightens regulations.
title_i18n.es: Análisis: El nuevo presupuesto británico exime a las criptomonedas de nuevos impuestos, pero intensifica la regulación.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 英国财政大臣里夫斯在周三发布的《秋季财政声明》中，未进一步提高去年已影响加密货币投资者的资本利得税税率。双子座（Gemini）英国合规主管Azariah Nukajam对这一决定表示欢迎。“很高兴看到加密货币不会被征新税，这意味着加密货币正被视为与其他资产类别同等的存在，确保其长期成为可行的另类投资选择，”她表示。 不过，Nukajam指出，英国近期的立法和监管公告（如《成文法文件草案》中针对加密货币公司的拟议新规），再加上此次预算案声明，表明“更严格、更接近‘传统金融’模式的监管以及税务透明度要求将按计划推进”。（新浪财经）
excerpt_i18n.en: British Chancellor of the Exchequer Reeves did not further increase the capital gains tax rate, which had affected cryptocurrency investors last year, in the Autumn Fiscal Statement released on Wednesday. Azariah Nukajam, Head of Compliance at Gemini UK, welcomed this decision. She expressed pleasure that no new taxes would be imposed on cryptocurrency, indicating it is being treated on par with other asset classes and ensuring its viability as an alternative long-term investment option. However, Nukajam noted that recent UK legislative and regulatory announcements, such as the proposed new rules for cryptocurrency companies in the Draft Statutory Instrument, combined with this budget statement, suggest that stricter regulation closer to the traditional finance model and tax transparency requirements will proceed as planned.
excerpt_i18n.es: El ministro de Hacienda británico, Reeves, no incrementó la tasa del impuesto sobre ganancias de capital que ya afectó a inversores en criptomonedas el año pasado, según la Declaración Fiscal de Otoño publicada el miércoles. Azariah Nukajam, directora de cumplimiento de Gemini en el Reino Unido, acogió con satisfacción esta decisión. "Es positivo ver que no se imponen nuevos impuestos a las criptomonedas, lo que significa que están siendo tratadas en pie de igualdad con otras clases de activos, asegurando su viabilidad a largo plazo como opción de inversión alternativa", señaló. Sin embargo, Nukajam destacó que los recientes anuncios legislativos y regulatorios en el Reino Unido, como las nuevas normas propuestas para empresas de criptomonedas en el Proyecto de Instrumento Legal, junto con esta declaración presupuestaria.

excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, Alibaba's wholesale platform 1688 launched the cross-border e-commerce AI agent "Ao Xia," which intelligently matches cross-border entrepreneurs with quality factories and efficiently streamlines the digital process from product selection to supply chain integration. Centered on "AI + supply chain," "Ao Xia" integrates image recognition, link parsing, and natural language interaction technologies, covering key stages such as product decision-making, factory sourcing, intelligent pricing inquiries, and content generation to offer a one-stop smart digital supply chain solution. Users can initiate a conversation, upload product images, or input product links to start the entire workflow from market research to factory coordination with a single click. Apart from order placement and payment, which require user confirmation, all other steps can be automated by AI. Currently, the "Ao Xia" AI agent is available for a limited time free of charge on its official website (alphashop.cn), serving global cross-border professionals under the overseas brand name AlphaShop. (Ao Xia user interface screenshot) Data shows that there are approximately over a million active cross-border e-commerce merchants in China, while domestic e-commerce sellers exceed ten million. Encouraging more domestic merchants to expand overseas is becoming a new growth driver. Currently, 1688's annual cross-border transaction volume has surpassed 200 billion yuan, but issues like blind product selection, inefficient factory sourcing, high communication costs, slow responses, and weak design capabilities have long hindered the development of small and medium-sized businesses. The launch of "Ao Xia" aims to systematically address these problems by reshaping cross-border operational efficiency through AI. In the product selection phase, "Ao Xia" automatically generates insights based on data from mainstream e-commerce platforms and consumer trends.

items.title: 2025字节跳动奖学金公布：奖金翻倍至20万元，追加奖励导师10万元
items.raw_excerpt: 近日，2025年字节跳动奖学金颁奖典礼在北京举行，共20位博士获奖。相比往届，此次奖学金不仅增加了获奖名额，也将奖学金从10万元升级为20万元（含10万元现金、10万元专项学术资源补贴）。此外，字节跳动还为每位获奖同学的导师提供10万元奖励，感谢导师在学子成长与科研道路上的付出。 图：20位获奖同学合影 字节跳动奖学金计划始于2021年，希望寻找并激励最优秀的技术在校生，助力其学术及科研，用技术回馈社会。过去五年，该计划已经为67位优秀学子提供了科研支持。 据统计，2025年字节跳动奖学金计划收到了中国、新加坡66所高校500余名同学的申请。经过严格评审，来自清华、北大、人大、复旦、华中科技大学、香港大学、新加坡国立大学、南洋理工大学的20位学子获奖，覆盖大模型、机器学习、多模态、AI Infra、机器人、AI for Science、硬件等多个研究领域。 本届字节跳动奖学金获奖名单中，清华和北大入选的人数最多，各入选6人。人大和香港大学也各有2位同学获奖。获奖同学表示，字节奖学金是对他们研究成果的认可，也通过该项目，接触到工业界的技术实践、认识到不同研究领域的优秀人才。一些获奖导师表示，此前已经和字节在相关研究领域开展了深入合作，字节为高校学术研究和人才培养提供了资源支持。 颁奖典礼上，字节跳动技术副总裁杨震原对获奖师生表示祝贺，并分享了字节跳动在大规模推荐系统、AI for Science、XR、大模型等领域长期探索的经验，鼓励同学们保持耐心和热爱，挑战真正有高度的技术难题，为社会创造更大价值。

Recently, the 2025 ByteDance Scholarship award ceremony was held in Beijing, honoring 20 doctoral recipients. Compared to previous years, this edition increased the number of awards and raised the scholarship amount from 100,000 yuan to 200,000 yuan, which includes 100,000 yuan in cash and 100,000 yuan in dedicated academic resource subsidies. Additionally, ByteDance provided a 100,000 yuan reward to each recipient's supervisor in recognition of their contributions to the students' growth and research endeavors. 

The ByteDance Scholarship program was launched in 2021 with the aim of identifying and motivating top technical students to support their academic and research efforts, encouraging them to give back to society through technology. Over the past five years, the program has provided research support to 67 outstanding students. 

Statistics show that the 2025 ByteDance Scholarship program received applications from over 500 students across 66 universities in China and Singapore. excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, Doubao AI partnered with the School of Philosophy at Zhejiang University to jointly establish the "AI Humanities Innovation Laboratory." The two parties will continue to offer courses and training camps to cultivate students' AI literacy and practical skills, conduct long-term research on university students' AI usage behaviors and needs, gather genuine feedback on product models and functions, and explore unique applications among more faculty and student groups. Wang Jun, Dean of the School of Philosophy, stated on-site that this cross-disciplinary platform is not a simple combination of new technology and humanities but aims to build a symbiotic system where "humanities guide technology and technology enriches humanities." He expressed hope that through this collaboration, students will develop the composite ability to "harness technology with humanistic thinking and interpret humanities with technological means." At the training camp, 59 participants from humanities majors such as the School of Philosophy were divided into 10 groups, applying their disciplinary knowledge to transform expertise into visual outcomes, efficient learning aids, and innovative application solutions. Some used AI to create educational programs linking natural plants with traditional culture, while others aimed to develop AI applications to help people study "The Republic" in its original language. This is not the first collaboration between Doubao and the School of Philosophy at Zhejiang University. In May 2025, Doubao entered Zhejiang University.

El 25 por la tarde, se celebró la ceremonia de firma del acuerdo de colaboración en el campus Zijingang de la Universidad de Zhejiang, donde representantes de ambas partes inauguraron el nuevo laboratorio. Wang Jun, decano de la Facultad de Filosofía, destacó que este escenario interdisciplinario no es una simple superposición de tecnología y humanidades.

excerpt_i18n.en: This is a long-awaited moment in embodied intelligence: artificial intelligence is transitioning from eloquent speech on screens to the unity of knowledge and action in the physical world. On December 12, 2025, in Shanghai, China, the GDPS 2025 Global Developer Pioneer Conference and International Embodied Intelligence Skills Competition will officially commence. We are about to witness an industry realization spanning all four seasons. If the February Global Developer Pioneer Conference showcased a "blooming of a hundred flowers" in software algorithms, then this year-end GDPS event is dedicated to delivering the "abundant fruits" of hardware implementation. Promises about intelligence are made in spring, and answers about embodiment are reaped by year's end. Here, it is not the calendar seasons that are followed, but the cycle of innovation—spring blossoms yield autumn harvests, and implementation reigns supreme. As the world's first top-tier competition in embodied intelligence to comprehensively benchmark the "WorldSkills" standards, this is not just a contest of technology but the ultimate test to verify whether silicon-based life can truly integrate into human production and daily life. If 2023 was the "awakening moment" for large models and 2024 the "trial year" for AI applications, then in 2025, we will witness the full-scale explosion of "physical intelligence" here. This time, the competition no longer solely pits the speed of code execution but introduces human artisans.
excerpt_i18n.es: Es un momento largamente esperado en el ámbito de la inteligencia encarnada: la inteligencia artificial está pasando de ser "elocuente en pantalla" a "unificar conocimiento y acción en el mundo físico". El 12 de diciembre de 2025, en Shanghái, China, dará comienzo oficialmente la Conferencia Global de Desarrolladores Pioneros GDPS 2025 y la Competición Internacional de Habilidades de Inteligencia Encarnada. Estamos a punto de presenciar una materialización industrial que abarcará las cuatro estaciones. Si la Conferencia Global de Desarrolladores Pioneros de febrero mostró la "floración simultánea" de algoritmos de software, este evento culminante de GDPS a finales de año busca precisamente cumplir esa promesa.
